next_action: freeze evaluator before opening calendar-2023 post-entry outcomes

clock.entry: one full five-minute bar after that boundary
clock.feature_boundary: right edge of a completed UTC hour

eventual_execution.cagr: full declared wall-clock, including idle periods
frozen_controls: static alt breadth without leadership transition
eventual_execution.funding: realized funding cash flows on the held path
eventual_execution.position_state: one BTC position maximum; skip signals until fixed exit
eventual_execution.strict_mdd: global pre-entry high-water mark plus held OHLC path

allowed_before_evaluator_freeze: completed alt and BTC bars at or before each feature boundary
event timestamps, sides, and overlap with prior clocks
forbidden_before_evaluator_freeze: PnL, equity, CAGR, MDD, hit rate, or payoff

feature_formula.btc_lag: direction * (median_alt_trailing_6h_return_t - btc_trailing_6h_return_t) > 0; both end at the completed feature boundary, never after it
feature_formula.flow_alignment: fraction of flow_z signs with common_direction
feature_formula.flow_z: current flow standardized by strictly prior 30-day history
feature_formula.leader_decline: prior leader share at t-6h minus its current share
feature_formula.participation: fraction of six alt returns with common_direction
feature_formula.prior_state: residual HHI and leader weights six hours earlier
feature_formula.tie_contract: average ranks; exact leader ties resolve by frozen SYMBOLS order

protocol.hypothesis: BTC tends to catch up when a six-hour alt move changes from single-name concentration to broad participation, the old leader loses share, current taker flow agrees, and BTC still trails

live_parity.hour_requirement: exactly twelve completed five-minute bars per symbol
live_parity.joins: exact UTC timestamps only; no nearest, ffill, or bfill
live_parity.rolling_thresholds: shifted one row and exclude the current observation

sequential_oos.failed_stage_action: retire the exact frozen policy without repair

support_selection.selection_rule: among support-passing cells, maximize participation, flow alignment, HHI contraction, leader decline, turnover, prior concentration, then move threshold; never use a return tie-break
